literal: Arisen affliction removing, [future affliction] not happening beforehand protecting, those of [such] character, cherishing, acquiring.
translation: To cherish and secure the friendship of those who can dispel existing troubles and guard against future ones before they occur.
modern: வந்துள்ள துன்பத்தை நீக்கி, இனிமேல் துன்பம் வராமல் முன்னதாகவே காக்கும் தன்மை உடைய பெரியோர்களைப் போற்றித் துணையாகக் கொள்ள வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the essential qualities of the wise guides whom a leader should seek as companions. They possess two key abilities: first, they can resolve and remove troubles that have already occurred; second, they can foresee and prevent future difficulties before they arise. A wise ruler must cherish and secure the guidance of such capable mentors to ensure steady and safe governance.
